title: Polish-Style Sauerkraut and Pierogi Casserole
description: A hearty, comforting casserole combining sauerkraut, pierogi, and a touch of Polish flair. Perfect for a chilly evening.

ingredients.name: Polish sausage
ingredients.notes: Optional, can substitute with vegetarian sausage

instructions: Cook the sliced Polish sausage in a pan over medium heat until browned, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
In a separate pan, sauté the quenched (caraway seeds) and sauerkraut over medium heat until the mixture is heated through.
In a greased 9x13-inch baking dish, arrange half of the pierogi.
Top the pierogi with the cooked sausage and sauerkraut mixture.
Arrange the remaining pierogi on top.
Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the pierogi are golden brown.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
